values.甲: You grow toward the light you believe in — even where nothing shelters you.
values.乙: You bend where others break — and call it nothing, though it is everything.
values.丙: You warm every room you enter — and rarely ask who warms you.
values.丁: You keep a small fire no storm has found — others read by its light.
values.戊: You hold what others set down — so long, they forget the weight was theirs.
values.己: Everything you tend grows — you are the last to call it your harvest.
values.庚: You say what others soften — and pay, quietly, for being the one who did.
values.辛: You were polished by what pressed you — brilliance is the part that survived.
values.壬: You hold more than anyone thinks to ask about — depth was never meant to be seen.
values.癸: You change things slowly, softly, completely — and let the credit fall elsewhere.
